ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.1.3 Map Pawn Cache Guard
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT T34-D.1.3 for RimWorld 1.5, based directly on the measured T34-C.4 baseline. Large JobGiver GenClosest scans are divided across the persistent RimMT worker pool. Worker validators bypass T20 transaction counters and Harmony argument-array allocation. Direct and nested Reachability calls, plus the measured mutable MapPawns colony-animal cache entry point, are intercepted before worker-side shared-state mutation, causing a silent current-call fallback and runtime scanner quarantine. Priority callbacks and default JobOnThing-backed validators remain on the main thread.
